brief:
Shehab Wire reported that Israeli Mossad chief Romain Golani has undertaken efforts to persuade Washington to launch a joint military strike against Iran. The push comes as Prime Minister Netanyahu's government seeks to resume confrontation with Tehran, according to reporting by Reuters.

The initiative faces American hesitation and regional concerns about escalation widening, the report indicated. Israel's diplomatic efforts signal mounting pressure within the government to draw the United States into a new military engagement.

title: Israeli intelligence chief pushes U.S. toward military confrontation with Iran
